promotions.detail: Some Italian favourites are worth making room for.
promotions.story: Some Italian favourites are worth making room for. From the bright, comforting flavours of Lemon Chicken Risotto to the creamy indulgence of Tiramisu, let Tuscany take you through a little savoury-to-sweet journey. Join us at Tuscany in Trident, Hyderabad and savour the classics. We look forward to hosting you at Tuscany.
